headline: Wayne State win as Grand Valley State lose
dek: Wayne State won their non-conference match and have lost only twice all season, to Davenport and Ferris State. Grand Valley State and Saginaw Valley State both lost theirs.
displaced_by: Wayne State beat their non-conference opponent while Grand Valley State and Saginaw Valley State both lost theirs
